info.title: Uta no Prince Sama Legend Star
info.synopsis: Quarta Stagione del brand Uta no Prince-sama. Nella serie originale seguiamo le vicende di una ragazza che frequenta un istituto d'arte focalizzato sul canto, sulla composizione e sulla stesura dei testi delle canzoni. La protagonista, è attorniata da fascinosi compagni di scuola, tutti bishouen idol in erba.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: When QUARTET NIGHT is chosen to perform as the Triple S Opening Artist, they decline the opportunity after STARISH and HEAVENS give equally compelling performances. Raging Otori and Shining Saotome propose another musical showdown to determine the opening artist between the three groups in which all three of them must sing songs written by Haruka! Who will win the decisive concert and the honor of performing at the Triple S?

tvdb.title: Lasting Oneness
tvdb.synopsis: Masato is called back to the Hijirikawa family after his father collapses which puts a strain on his duet project with Kira. Upon returning home, Masato is pressurised into taking over the family business prompting Ren and Kira to confront him about his true ambitions.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: The theme of Otoya and Eiichi's song is a "soul-shaking song." When Eiichi explains to Otoya that he must face his true self that exists deep inside his heart to do so, he stoically engages in writing the lyrics. However, gradually he becomes less and less like himself.
